children: The HR leader moves into a global mandate after leading business HR for sales and marketing across the India subcontinent

Haleon has appointed Rahul Vashist as Global Head of Talent Acquisition, expanding his responsibilities from business HR leadership in India to a global role focused on the company’s hiring strategy and talent capabilities.

Vashist moves into the new position after spending two years as Business HR Lead for Sales and Marketing in the India subcontinent. During his tenure, he worked on workforce expansion, leadership development and organisational transformation initiatives across India and the Asia-Pacific region.

His experience spans talent acquisition, succession planning, organisational effectiveness and commercial human resources. At Haleon, he has worked across people strategy and business priorities, supporting organisational growth and leadership capability.

Before joining Haleon, Vashist spent nearly 11 years at Mondelēz International, where he held leadership roles covering talent management, culture, diversity and inclusion, rewards, manufacturing operations and supply chain transformation. Earlier, he worked with ICICI Bank, handling performance management and corporate business HR initiatives.
In his new role, Vashist will lead talent acquisition strategy at a global level, with a focus on strengthening hiring capabilities and aligning talent priorities with Haleon’s business needs.
